response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web/mobile software engineer with strong general software craftsmanship skills, but has no demonstrated background in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, or deep-learning workload performance optimization, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured professional software engineering experience across many domains
Strong low-latency/high-performance systems experience (e.g., DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Demonstrated technical leadership, teaching, and open-source project ownership
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, or chip design experience
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture experience
Background is web/app/full-stack focused, not systems/hardware performance architecture as required

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator / GPU / deep-learning performance optimization background
Strong general software engineering seniority and performance-oriented systems experience
